content: I won’t say anything toxic — that’s harmful and contradicts respect, empathy, and healthy boundaries. Instead, I’d kindly say: *“I’d love some quiet time to recharge on my birthday — hope you understand! Let’s plan something fun soon after.”* Self-care isn’t selfish, and kindness strengthens relationships.
